title_fa: کایرو – مردی که زمان را شکست داد
title_en: KAIRO – The Man Who Defeated Time

voice.tone: medium-low, warm, slightly mysterious, natural Iranian conversational accent

continuity_anchors.kairo: stickman, slightly oversized round head, small black dot eyes, simple expressive eyebrows, movable mouth line, four short hair strands, thin simple arms and legs, slightly oversized feet. Proportions never change.
continuity_anchors.kairo_present: black business suit, white shirt, black tie, dark shoes
continuity_anchors.kairo_prehistoric: simple primitive brown animal-hide tunic, bare feet, wooden spear while hunting. No modern accessories.
continuity_anchors.predator: large prehistoric big-cat-like predator: low heavy shoulders, massive head, short rounded ears, long thick tail, tawny-grey matted fur with a dark dorsal stripe
continuity_anchors.map: circular amber stone tablet, concentric rings, twelve radial grooves, star-point markers, unknown angular glyphs, one blank destination node
continuity_anchors.cave: narrow south-facing entrance in a rock outcrop above dry grass, 40 m descending passage with a right-hand bend, then a large domed chamber with a waist-high stone platform at its centre
continuity_anchors.room: dark modern room, single worn leather armchair, warm yellow floor lamp on camera-left, heavy curtain camera-right, round wall clock above the chair

scenes.title: A Mysterious Beginning
scenes.shot: wide establishing, slow push-in to medium close-up
scenes.camera: slow dolly push from wide to face height, 1.00x to 1.25x
scenes.action: KAIRO sits in the armchair, one side of his body lit by the floor lamp. He looks directly into the lens and introduces himself with a small, self-deprecating shrug.
scenes.expression: warm, faintly amused, a little uncertain
scenes.lighting: warm tungsten key from camera-left, deep blue-black shadow camera-right, dust motes in the beam
scenes.audio: low warm string pad, sparse piano notes, faint room tone and a slow clock tick
scenes.dialogue_fa: سلام... من کایرو هستم. راستش نمی‌دونم از کجا شروع کنم... چون داستان من یه‌کم با بقیه فرق داره.
scenes.gloss_en: Hello... I'm Kairo. Honestly, I don't know where to start... because my story is a little different from everyone else's.
scenes.transition: cut on the last word; camera still settling
scenes.image_prompt: Wide cinematic interior of a dark modern room. A stickman named KAIRO sits in a worn leather armchair, wearing a black business suit with white shirt and black tie, dark shoes on the floor. A warm yellow floor lamp stands on the left and paints a golden rim on one half of his oversized round head; the other half falls into deep shadow. Heavy curtain right, round wall clock above the chair, dust motes drifting in the lamp beam. Painterly 2D animation background, layered depth, soft vignette.
scenes.video_prompt: Static wide frame of the dark room, then a very slow cinematic push-in toward KAIRO's face over twelve seconds. KAIRO blinks twice naturally, small mouth movement as he speaks, eyebrows lift on the first line then settle. Slight breathing in the shoulders, tiny flicker in the floor lamp. Camera never shakes; the push is perfectly smooth.

scenes.title: People and Their Hurry
scenes.shot: medium shot, chest up
scenes.camera: almost locked off, imperceptible drift, framing continuous with S01
scenes.action: Same room and seat. KAIRO speaks to camera with small natural hand gestures; on the last line he gradually leans forward with a thoughtful expression.
scenes.lighting: identical to S01, lamp beam unchanged
scenes.audio: pad continues, clock tick slightly louder, single low piano note under the lean
scenes.dialogue_fa: تا حالا دقت کردی همه عجله دارن؟ یکی دنبال پوله، یکی دنبال موفقیته، یکی هم فقط می‌خواد زودتر به فردا برسه.
scenes.gloss_en: Have you ever noticed that everyone is in a hurry? One chases money, one chases success, and one just wants to reach tomorrow faster.
scenes.transition: his eye-line shift motivates the cut to the clock
scenes.image_prompt: Medium shot of KAIRO the stickman seated in the armchair, black suit and tie, warm lamp light on the left of his face. His right hand is raised in a small open gesture as if explaining something. The dark modern room and the wall clock sit slightly out of focus behind him. Cinematic 2D animation still, soft depth of field, warm-cool contrast.
scenes.video_prompt: Continuous medium shot. KAIRO talks with small natural hand gestures and blinks, and on the final phrase leans forward toward the lens with a thoughtful head tilt. Camera drifts imperceptibly. Background identical to the previous shot.

scenes.title: Forgetting Today
scenes.shot: medium close-up, three-quarter angle
scenes.camera: slow tilt from the wall clock down to KAIRO
scenes.action: KAIRO turns his head toward the wall clock behind him and pauses. Then he turns back to camera and opens one hand gently.
scenes.lighting: warm lamp key, thin highlight on the clock rim
scenes.audio: clock tick moves to the foreground, pad thins out
scenes.dialogue_fa: همه می‌گن وقتی به فلان چیز برسم، اون‌وقت زندگی می‌کنم. ولی کسی نمی‌دونه شاید همون لحظه‌ای که منتظرشی، دیگه هیچ‌وقت برنگرده.
scenes.gloss_en: Everyone says when I reach such-and-such, then I'll live. But nobody knows that the moment you are waiting for may never come back.
scenes.transition: match on his turn back to camera; the push-in begins
scenes.image_prompt: Three-quarter medium close-up in the dark room. KAIRO the stickman has turned his head to look up at a round wall clock above the armchair, a thin highlight tracing the clock rim. Suit collar and tie clearly readable, lamp light grazing his round head. Painterly 2D cinematic still, atmospheric shadow.
scenes.video_prompt: Camera tilts slowly down from the ticking wall clock to KAIRO. He holds the look for two beats, blinks once, then turns back to the lens and opens one hand gently. The clock hand advances. Lighting unchanged.

scenes.title: Something Changed
scenes.shot: close-up on face
scenes.camera: locked close-up, then micro push-in
scenes.action: KAIRO's slight smile fades. He leans back into the chair and looks into the distance, remembering.
scenes.lighting: one side of the face lit, the other eye in shadow
scenes.audio: clock tick stops, low sub-bass swell begins
scenes.dialogue_fa: منم یه زمانی مثل همه فکر می‌کردم... تا اینکه یه اتفاقی افتاد. اتفاقی که همه‌چیز رو عوض کرد.
scenes.gloss_en: I used to think like everyone else... until something happened. Something that changed everything.
scenes.transition: push continues into the eyes, setting up the match cut in S05
scenes.image_prompt: Tight cinematic close-up of KAIRO's oversized round stickman head. Small black elliptical eyes, thin expressive eyebrows, a simple mouth line losing its smile, four short hair strands. Lamp light on the left half of the face only, right half sinking into black. Black suit collar and white shirt edge at the bottom of frame. Painterly 2D animation, fine film grain, shallow depth.
scenes.video_prompt: Locked close-up. The faint smile disappears, eyebrows flatten, he exhales and leans back out of the light, eyes drifting off lens into the distance. Extremely slow micro push-in. A low sub-bass swell rises under the silence.

scenes.title: Entering a Memory
scenes.shot: extreme close-up of the eyes, then match cut to a savanna sunrise
scenes.camera: macro push into the pupil; the pupil iris-wipes into a sunrise horizon line
scenes.action: Macro shot of KAIRO's eyes. A tiny reflection of warm sunrise light appears in each pupil. The reflection expands until the frame is the African savanna at sunrise.
scenes.expression: eyes only: calm, then a flicker of memory
scenes.lighting: eye highlights turn from lamp-yellow to sunrise-gold
scenes.audio: pad dissolves into wind; a warm low string note opens the memory
scenes.dialogue_fa: بذار برگردیم به همون روز... روزی که فکر می‌کردم فقط یه شکار معمولیه.
scenes.gloss_en: Let's go back to that day... the day I thought was just an ordinary hunt.
continuity: iris shape identical to S04 eyes
transition must land on the exact savanna of S06
scenes.transition: invisible match cut: pupil rim becomes the sun disk
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme macro of two small black stickman eyes filling the frame, each pupil holding a tiny warm sunrise reflection of golden grass and a low sun. Ink linework, painterly iris detail, deep shadow around the sockets. 2D cinematic animation detail shot.
scenes.video_prompt: Macro push into the pupils. The reflected sunrise inside each eye brightens and expands until it iris-wipes the whole frame into a wide golden savanna at sunrise. Seamless match cut, no flash, no dissolve, continuous single motion.

scenes.title: The Ancient World
scenes.shot: high aerial wide, then descend to ground level
scenes.camera: crane down from aerial to a ground-level wide over the grass
scenes.action: Prehistoric Africa at sunrise, 200,000 years ago. Golden grass, scattered acacia trees, distant hills. KAIRO rises out of the tall grass, wearing a brown animal-hide tunic, holding a wooden spear.
scenes.lighting: low golden sun, long shadows, warm haze on the hills
scenes.audio: wide wind, distant birds and insects, no music for the first two seconds
scenes.dialogue_fa: حدود دویست هزار سال پیش... آفریقا. نه خبری از شهر بود، نه ماشین، نه حتی یه سقف درست‌وحسابی بالای سرمون.
scenes.gloss_en: About two hundred thousand years ago... Africa. No cities, no cars, not even a proper roof over our heads.
scenes.transition: crane continues down, motivating the cut to the grass-level hunt
scenes.image_prompt: Sweeping aerial view of prehistoric African savanna at sunrise: oceans of golden dry grass, scattered flat-topped acacia trees, rocky outcrops, distant blue hills, warm haze. A small stickman figure in a brown animal-hide tunic stands in the tall grass holding a wooden spear, tiny against the landscape. Painterly 2D animation background, layered atmospheric depth, long shadows.
scenes.video_prompt: Slow cinematic crane descent from high aerial to ground level over the golden grass. Wind moves the grass in waves, dust drifts. KAIRO rises out of the grass and scans the horizon, spear in hand. Sun flare low on the left. No cuts.

scenes.title: The Hunt
scenes.shot: medium tracking shot, profile
scenes.camera: lateral tracking with KAIRO, then settle as he kneels
scenes.action: KAIRO moves cautiously through waist-high dry grass, spear low and ready. He stops, notices tracks, and kneels down to inspect them.
scenes.lighting: sunrise side light raking the grass, warm bounce from below
scenes.audio: grass brushing against legs, soft footsteps, insects, low wind
scenes.dialogue_fa: اون روز رفته بودم دنبال شکار. راستش گرسنه بودیم و چاره‌ای هم نداشتیم. باید چیزی برای خوردن پیدا می‌کردم.
scenes.gloss_en: That day I had gone out to hunt. Honestly, we were hungry and had no choice. I had to find something to eat.
scenes.transition: he kneels, motivating the cut to the footprint close-up
scenes.image_prompt: Medium profile tracking shot of KAIRO the stickman walking through waist-high golden dry grass in prehistoric Africa, wearing a simple brown animal-hide tunic, bare feet, a wooden spear held low in his right hand. Sunrise side light rakes the grass, long shadows, acacia trees soft in the background. Painterly 2D animation, warm dust in the air.
scenes.video_prompt: Lateral tracking shot following KAIRO through the tall grass. He pushes stalks aside with the spear shaft, stops, glances down at fresh tracks, and kneels slowly out of frame bottom. Grass sways in the wind, dust motes drift. Camera settles as he kneels.

scenes.title: Footprints
scenes.shot: close-up on footprints, tilt up to medium
scenes.camera: slow tilt from the ground up to KAIRO's face
scenes.action: Large fresh animal footprints pressed into dry soil. The camera tilts up to find KAIRO staring toward a dense wall of bushes.
scenes.expression: uncertain, a first hint of unease
scenes.lighting: hard low sun, strong texture on the soil
scenes.audio: wind drops away; a single low drone enters
scenes.dialogue_fa: ردپاها تازه بودن... خیلی تازه. فکر کردم بالاخره شانس آوردم. ولی یه چیزی درست به نظر نمی‌رسید.
scenes.gloss_en: The tracks were fresh... very fresh. I thought my luck had finally turned. But something didn't feel right.
continuity: same predator tracks as S09 threat
scenes.transition: tilt lands on his face at the exact scale of S09's first frame
scenes.image_prompt: Ground-level close-up of three huge fresh predator paw prints pressed deep into cracked dry soil, claw tips visible, dust at the edges. Beyond them, blurred golden grass. Painterly 2D animation, raking low sunlight, rich soil texture.
scenes.video_prompt: Slow tilt up from the oversized paw prints in the soil, past the grass stems, to KAIRO's face as he kneels and stares toward the dense bushes. Wind dies down. His eyebrows lower. Dust settles.

scenes.title: Danger
scenes.shot: medium close-up, then wide with deep focus
scenes.camera: locked on KAIRO, rack focus to the bushes behind him
scenes.action: KAIRO freezes in the grass and turns his head. A large mysterious predator silhouette slides behind the bushes. Only a shape and the sound of it are visible.
scenes.lighting: sun a little higher, bushes in deep shade
scenes.audio: breath held, low drone, a heavy body brushing through leaves
scenes.dialogue_fa: یه صدایی از پشت سرم اومد... اول فکر کردم باد بوده. ولی نه... یه چیزی اونجا بود.
scenes.gloss_en: I heard a sound behind me... at first I thought it was the wind. But no... something was there.
continuity: predator silhouette only, no detail reveal before S10
scenes.transition: the silhouette pushes through the leaves, motivating S10
scenes.image_prompt: Medium close-up of KAIRO the stickman frozen in tall golden grass, head half turned, eyes wide, animal-hide tunic, spear gripped tight. Behind him, out of focus, a huge dark predator silhouette slides behind a dense wall of bushes. Sunrise backlight, dust and haze. 2D cinematic animation, suspense composition.
scenes.video_prompt: Camera locked on KAIRO. He freezes mid-step, head turning first, body following. Focus racks from his face to the bushes behind him where a large dark shape moves slowly, pushing leaves aside. Only silhouette and shadow, no detail. Grass trembles.

scenes.title: The Predator
scenes.shot: wide low-angle, predator foreground
scenes.camera: low angle with a slow pull-back as the predator advances
scenes.action: A huge prehistoric big-cat predator steps out of the bushes into the light. KAIRO steps backward in fear and lifts his spear with both hands.
scenes.lighting: predator rim-lit by the sun, KAIRO in warm bounce light
scenes.audio: deep growl, grass crunch, low brass hit, drone rises
scenes.dialogue_fa: وقتی دیدمش، فهمیدم شکارچی واقعی منم! باور کن حتی فرصت نکردم فکر کنم.
scenes.gloss_en: When I saw it, I realised I was the real prey! Believe me, I didn't even get a chance to think.
continuity: predator design locked from here to S14
scenes.transition: the predator gathers its weight, motivating the cut to the run
scenes.image_prompt: Low wide shot in golden savanna grass. A massive prehistoric big-cat predator with low heavy shoulders, a huge head, short rounded ears and a thick tail stands at the edge of the bushes, rim-lit by sunrise, fur tawny-grey with a dark dorsal stripe. In the foreground KAIRO the stickman in a brown hide tunic backs away, wooden spear raised in both hands. 2D cinematic animation, dust, dramatic scale contrast.
scenes.video_prompt: Slow pull-back as the predator pushes out of the bushes one heavy step at a time, head low, shoulders rolling. KAIRO stumbles backward, raises the spear with both thin arms and freezes. The predator's tail flicks. Grass and dust move with the weight.

scenes.title: Escape
scenes.shot: dynamic tracking with handheld energy
scenes.camera: fast lateral tracking, then behind-the-shoulder chase, slight shake
scenes.action: The predator charges. KAIRO turns and sprints through tall grass, the predator closing behind him. Dust, flattened grass and blurred foreground.
scenes.expression: panic, mouth open, running for his life
scenes.lighting: dappled raking light, kicked-up dust glowing gold
scenes.audio: pounding footsteps, ragged breathing, heavy paws, driving percussion
scenes.dialogue_fa: فقط یه کار می‌تونستم بکنم... فرار! اونم با تمام سرعتی که داشتم.
scenes.gloss_en: There was only one thing I could do... run! With every bit of speed I had.
continuity: chase direction is screen-left to right
scenes.transition: he spots the rocks ahead, motivating S12
scenes.image_prompt: Kinetic chase frame: KAIRO the stickman sprints through tall golden grass, hide tunic flapping, spear clutched to his chest, dust exploding from his heels. Behind him a massive prehistoric predator gallops through the flattened grass, mouth open. Motion blur on the foreground grass, low sun flare, flying dust. Dynamic 2D cinematic animation.
scenes.video_prompt: Fast lateral tracking shot of the chase, then drop behind KAIRO's shoulder. He runs left to right, arms pumping, hide tunic flapping, grass whipping past. The predator follows in long heavy bounds, dust clouds rising. Slight handheld shake, speed lines, single continuous shot.

scenes.title: The Cave Entrance
scenes.shot: wide, then medium as he changes direction
scenes.camera: panning follow, then a whip pan onto the cave mouth
scenes.action: KAIRO bursts between rocks and grass, spots a dark cave entrance in a rock outcrop, and swerves toward it.
scenes.lighting: bright exterior light against the absolute black of the cave mouth
scenes.audio: percussion continues, wind, a hollow low tone from inside the cave
scenes.dialogue_fa: یه‌دفعه چشمم به یه غار افتاد. نمی‌دونستم داخلش چیه... ولی بیرون موندن قطعاً بدتر بود!
scenes.gloss_en: Suddenly I caught sight of a cave. I had no idea what was inside... but staying outside was definitely worse!
continuity: cave mouth sits above dry grass on the right side of a rock outcrop; reused in S13-S16
scenes.transition: whip pan follows him into the dark, motivating S13
scenes.image_prompt: Wide shot of a rocky outcrop above golden dry grass in prehistoric Africa, with a narrow dark cave mouth set in the rock face. KAIRO the stickman sprints toward it between boulders, hide tunic flapping, spear in hand. The cave interior is pure black, framed by sunlit stone. 2D cinematic animation, strong light-dark contrast, dust.
scenes.video_prompt: Panning follow shot of KAIRO running between boulders, then a fast whip pan that catches the black cave mouth in the rock face. He changes direction and drives toward it. Dust and grass seeds fly through frame. The darkness of the entrance holds against the bright exterior.

scenes.title: Entering the Cave
scenes.shot: medium from behind, entering the dark
scenes.camera: push forward following behind KAIRO into darkness
scenes.action: KAIRO rushes into the cave, stumbles on loose stone and catches his balance. Bright sunlight stays behind him as the camera follows him into the dark.
scenes.expression: relief mixed with panic, one quick backward glance
scenes.lighting: hard sunlight wedge on the floor, deep black beyond
scenes.audio: running footsteps become echoing steps, tight breathing, cave reverb
scenes.dialogue_fa: خودمو پرت کردم توی غار... و فقط امیدوار بودم اون موجود دنبالم نیاد.
scenes.gloss_en: I threw myself into the cave... just hoping that creature wouldn't follow me.
continuity: same cave mouth geometry as S12
scenes.transition: his backward glance sets up the reverse angle of S14
scenes.image_prompt: Interior of a cave mouth seen from just inside. KAIRO the stickman in a hide tunic stumbles forward into the dark, arms out for balance, spear still in one hand. A hard wedge of golden sunlight falls across the rocky floor behind him; the passage ahead is black. 2D cinematic animation, dust particles in the light beam, deep shadow.
scenes.video_prompt: Push forward from behind KAIRO as he runs in, trips on loose stone, catches himself against the wall and half-turns to look back at the daylight. Dust drifts through the sun wedge. The darkness beyond is native black with no fill light.

scenes.title: The Predator Stops
scenes.shot: deep-focus shot from inside the cave looking out
scenes.camera: locked, anchored inside the cave; the predator plays outside the mouth
scenes.action: From inside the cave: the predator arrives at the entrance, stops at the threshold, sniffs, hesitates, and slowly retreats. KAIRO is a small silhouette at frame-left edge, pressed against the rock.
scenes.lighting: bright exterior blown out, interior silhouette crushing to black
scenes.audio: sniffing, a low confused growl, then paw steps fading; cave reverb tail
scenes.dialogue_fa: ولی یه چیز عجیب اتفاق افتاد... اون حیوان رسید به دهانه غار، اما داخل نیومد. انگار از چیزی می‌ترسید!
scenes.gloss_en: But something strange happened... that animal reached the mouth of the cave, but it didn't come in. As if it was afraid of something!
continuity: predator must never cross the threshold
same cave mouth shape as S12/S13
scenes.transition: the predator's retreat empties the frame, motivating S15
scenes.image_prompt: View from deep inside a cave looking out at the bright entrance. The cave mouth is a jagged bright opening; a huge prehistoric predator stands just outside it, hesitant, head lowered, one paw raised, refusing to step over the threshold. Inside, rock walls fall into black, and a small stickman silhouette presses against the left wall. 2D cinematic animation, silhouettes against blown-out light.
scenes.video_prompt: Locked shot from inside the cave. The predator arrives at the mouth, stops dead, sniffs the air, shifts its weight forward then back, and slowly retreats out of frame. Dust and heat shimmer in the doorway. The interior remains black throughout.

scenes.title: Strange Silence
scenes.shot: medium from inside, then a slow push as he steps out from cover
scenes.camera: locked on the empty mouth, then a slow drift right to find KAIRO behind a rock
scenes.action: The entrance is empty, sunlight lying across the floor. KAIRO slowly comes out from behind a rock and looks outside, listening.
scenes.lighting: sun wedge on the floor, cool ambient bounce on the walls
scenes.audio: silence with a faint high ring; his breath is the loudest thing
scenes.dialogue_fa: چند لحظه همون‌جا موندم. نه صدایی... نه حرکتی... فقط یه سکوت عجیب. انگار غار نفسشو حبس کرده بود.
scenes.gloss_en: I stayed right there for a few moments. No sound... no movement... just a strange silence. As if the cave was holding its breath.
scenes.transition: silence is broken by a sound from behind him, motivating S16
scenes.image_prompt: Inside the cave mouth, the entrance empty and glowing with golden daylight, a hard wedge of sun on the rocky floor. KAIRO the stickman in a hide tunic peers out from behind a large rock at frame-left, only half of him visible, spear lowered. Dust suspended in the light. 2D cinematic animation, quiet composition, negative space.
scenes.video_prompt: Locked on the empty bright entrance, dust floating. The camera drifts slowly right and finds KAIRO easing out from behind a rock, one cautious step, head tilting to listen. He exhales. Nothing outside moves.

scenes.title: A Strange Sound
scenes.shot: medium close-up, backlit by the entrance
scenes.camera: slow orbit from front to profile as he turns
scenes.action: KAIRO stands near the entrance. A mysterious sound drifts up from deep inside the cave. He turns sharply toward the dark passage.
scenes.lighting: warm daylight rim from behind him, black passage in front
scenes.audio: a low resonant tone with a faint pulse, like a struck stone; cave reverb
scenes.dialogue_fa: همون موقع یه صدا شنیدم... یه صدای عجیب. نه شبیه صدای حیوان بود، نه شبیه صدای آدم.
scenes.gloss_en: Right then I heard a sound... a strange sound. It was not like an animal, and not like a human voice.
continuity: passage opening is camera-right of the entrance wall, recreated in S17-S18
scenes.transition: his turn completes the move into the passage, motivating S17
scenes.image_prompt: Medium close-up of KAIRO the stickman standing at the cave entrance, backlit by warm daylight so his hide tunic and spear edge glow, face in soft shadow. Behind him the black passage opening. Small dust motes curl in the light. 2D cinematic animation, strong rim lighting, moody.
scenes.video_prompt: Slow orbit around KAIRO from the front to his profile. A resonant tone sounds; his head snaps toward the dark passage, eyebrows lifting, one hand tightening on the spear. The light behind him stays constant.

scenes.title: Curiosity
scenes.shot: close-up on the face, then medium as he steps in
scenes.camera: slow push-in on the face, then follow his step
scenes.action: KAIRO stares into the dark passage. Confusion turns to curiosity. He takes one slow step forward.
scenes.lighting: the last daylight behind him, the passage ahead by a single cool bounce
scenes.audio: the tone repeats, closer; the wind outside fades out completely
scenes.dialogue_fa: عجیب‌تر این بود که از صدا نمی‌ترسیدم... یه جورایی حس می‌کردم باید برم ببینم چیه.
scenes.gloss_en: The strangest part was that the sound didn't frighten me... somehow I felt I had to go and see what it was.
scenes.transition: his step becomes the rear tracking shot of S18
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of KAIRO's face half lit by daylight from behind, eyes fixed on something off-frame in the dark. His expression shifts from confusion to fascination, eyebrows rising, mouth slightly open. Beyond him, the black throat of a rocky passage. 2D cinematic animation, high contrast, texture in the stone.
scenes.video_prompt: Slow push-in on KAIRO's face as he stares into the dark. His brow smooths, curiosity replacing fear. He takes one deliberate step forward, spear now hanging loose at his side, and the shadows take half of his face.

scenes.title: The Dark Passage
scenes.shot: rear tracking shot
scenes.camera: steadicam follow behind KAIRO, deepening darkness, faint glow ahead
scenes.action: KAIRO walks deeper into a narrow rocky passage. A faint mysterious light becomes visible in the distance.
scenes.expression: not visible; posture is careful, hand trailing the wall
scenes.lighting: almost no light; a cold blue-green glow far ahead, warm memory of daylight behind
scenes.audio: echoing footsteps, dripping water, the resonant tone growing clearer
scenes.dialogue_fa: هرچی جلوتر می‌رفتم، صدا واضح‌تر می‌شد. نمی‌دونستم دارم به چی نزدیک می‌شم...
scenes.gloss_en: The further I went, the clearer the sound became. I had no idea what I was getting close to...
continuity: passage bends right before the chamber, recreated in S19
scenes.transition: the glow grows until it fills frame, motivating the chamber reveal
scenes.image_prompt: Rear tracking shot of KAIRO the stickman walking down a narrow rocky cave passage, one thin hand trailing the wall, spear over his shoulder. The passage narrows and bends to the right; a faint cold blue-green glow leaks from around the bend. Rough stone texture, wet highlights, deep blacks. 2D cinematic animation, claustrophobic composition.
scenes.video_prompt: Steadicam follow behind KAIRO walking deeper. He slows, touches the wall, then keeps going. The passage narrows, shadows crowd the edges of frame, and the glow around the bend gradually brightens until it starts to fill the screen.

scenes.title: The Unknown Chamber
scenes.shot: wide reveal from the passage mouth, then medium
scenes.camera: emerge from the passage and crane up into the dome
scenes.action: The narrow passage opens into a huge underground chamber. In its centre stands an ancient stone platform. KAIRO stops and stares.
